newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador may reform to free up foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador may reform to free up foreign investment.

text.p: The Ecuadorian government has presented a constitutional reform package which would allow foreign capital to invest unrestricted in the country's strategic economic sectors, officials said Wednesday.

Ecuador currently considers "strategic" the state electricity and telecommunications companies and the state oil company, Petroecuador. However the privatization process for the first two has already been launched.

"We presented the project Tuesday. The constitution currently says certain services can be handed over, in exceptional cases, as concessions. We want to take out the exceptional bit," said the government's head of political reform, Armando Pareja.
